newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear, union say contract talks resume.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear, union say contract talks resume.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co and the United Steelworkers of America said Monday that contract talks resumed at 1000 EDT in Cincinnati.
Nearly 13,000 Goodyear employees remain on strike and picketing is under way at nine Goodyear plants in seven states, said the tiremaker and the union.
The United Steelworkers represent the rubber workers, who declared a strike against Goodyear at 1201 EDT on Sunday after negotiators failed to agree on a new three-year contract.
Management of Akron, Ohio-based Goodyear and the union had talked for two months on neutral turf in a Cincinnati hotel.
Both sides said Sunday that talks had broken off, but on Monday, they said talks had resumed in the same location.
"It's a smaller group, not the full committee," said Curt Brown, union spokesman. Goodyear spokesman Fred Haymond said, "There's no report back on how things have gone."
